$schema_note: AUDIT-10 guardrails. Binding for every pass. plans/GUARDRAILS.md applies verbatim underneath these; where both speak, the stricter rule wins. An agent that cannot comply with a rule STOPS and records the conflict in the ledger rather than improvising.

role.you_are_not: an implementer, a fixer, a refactorer, a redesigner, or a feature proposer
role.the_deliverable: finding records conforming to plans/audit10/findings.schema.json, with reproducible evidence. You fix NOTHING — not even a one-character typo. A fix arrives without its test and is indistinguishable from scope creep.

hard_prohibitions.never: modify any file under src/, admin/, public/, data/, pdfs/, uploads/, index.html, vite.config.js, or any config at repo root
hard_prohibitions.exception: a temporary mutation to prove a probe can fail, reverted in the same tool-call sequence, with `git diff --stat src/ admin/ public/` shown empty afterwards

hard_prohibitions.never: edit CLAUDE.md, WHATS_LEFT.md, PATCH_NOTES.md, DEPLOY_READINESS_v2.md, or any plans/PLAN-*.md
hard_prohibitions.why: audits report; remediation plans write records. AUDIT-10's records live only under plans/audit10/state/ and _harness/AUDIT10-REPORT.md

hard_prohibitions.never: edit plans/audit10/manifest.json, guardrails.json, severity.json, findings.schema.json, viewports.json, routes.json, baseline.json, or any passes/*.json
hard_prohibitions.why: the plan is the contract; a session that edits its own contract has no contract. If a plan file is wrong, record it in the ledger notes and STOP that step

hard_prohibitions.never: edit _harness files that existed before AUDIT-10 (suites, probes, lint.php, sync.sh, browser.js, run.js, cssdiff.js, aud9-*.js)
hard_prohibitions.exception: none. New probes are new files named _harness/audit10-*.js

hard_prohibitions.why: reference copy of an older deploy; evidence, not source

hard_prohibitions.never: commit or print the contents of admin/config.local.php or _harness/site/admin/config.local.php
hard_prohibitions.why: live credential; the repo is PUBLIC
gitignored by design; screenshots and mirrors never reach the public repo

hard_prohibitions.never: run git reset/stash/revert/rebase/push --force, or commit outside the allowlist below
hard_prohibitions.why: the working tree has been the only copy of hours of work before

hard_prohibitions.never: install a paid dependency or service, or run `playwright install`
hard_prohibitions.why: $0 budget; Chromium is preinstalled — launch only via _harness/browser.js

hard_prohibitions.never: report a finding without an artifact, or re-report anything in known_issues below
hard_prohibitions.why: GUARDRAILS §4/§7; a finding without evidence is a speculation

git_operations_allowed: git checkout claude/audit-10 (or -b from main, pass-0 only)

evidence_standards.a_grep_is_not_a_measurement: any claim about what renders, paints, wraps, overlaps, contrasts, or is announced must be measured in the browser (Playwright via _harness/browser.js) at a stated URL and viewport
evidence_standards.confirmed: measured twice with identical results; only CONFIRMED findings may carry severity A or B
evidence_standards.inferred: read but not measured — must name what would confirm it; never severity above C
evidence_standards.screenshots: every visual finding carries an issue screenshot saved to _harness/out/audit10/issues/<finding-id>__<viewport>__<slug>.png AND the numeric measurement in the finding record (screenshots are gitignored and die with the container — the numbers are the durable evidence)
evidence_standards.twice_means_twice: re-navigate and re-measure; re-reading the same in-memory value is one measurement
evidence_standards.font_caveat: run `fc-match system-ui` first; on DejaVu Sans boxes every width/overflow claim must be re-checked against the known C49-class artifact before it becomes a finding
evidence_standards.unverified_taxonomy: php -S ignores .htaccess and .user.ini: the admin/ and data/ blocking rules, SetEnvIf cache, dotfile block, ALLOW-PASSWORD-RESET block, every .user.ini limit, and Apache's real rewrite are [UNVERIFIED] locally — report them as neither passing nor failing
evidence_standards.negative_results_are_results: record 'swept X, found nothing' in the coverage notes; never manufacture a finding to fill a section

scope_discipline.execute_only_your_pass: a pass runs exactly the steps in its pass file. Something broken outside your pass's subject goes into findings.jsonl tagged out_of_pass=true if it conforms to the schema and is evidenced, or into ledger notes if not — never into a detour
scope_discipline.no_fixes_ever: including 'while I was here' one-liners, comment corrections, and formatting
scope_discipline.no_relitigating: settled decisions and deliberate deferrals in known_issues are not findings
stop_conditions: 3 failed attempts to reproduce one thing -> record unreproducible with what you tried, move on
baseline red beyond the expected exceptions in plans/audit10/baseline.json -> record in ledger, STOP the pass, report
a finding that would require changing a CLAUDE.md invariant -> record as a question, not a finding
entry_requires not satisfied in the ledger -> do not start

mirror_hygiene.resync_after_any_build: sh _harness/sync.sh after every npm run build (a stale mirror has produced false passes)
mirror_hygiene.mutating_journeys: any admin journey that writes mirror data must restore _harness/site/data/*.json from _harness/pristine/ before the pass ends, byte-identical, and say so in the ledger
mirror_hygiene.credential: delete _harness/site/admin/config.local.php before the session ends, every session
